    Guide: Cooldowns (Warcraft Tavern) · Cooldowns (Icy Veins)
  • Mighty Rage Potion: 1 of 2 possible uses≈ +1 DPS
    You used it at 0:50. It sat ready for 50s before you pressed it, which pushed every later use back. It was ready again at 2:50 and the fight ended at 3:30. Even a short window is worth pressing it.
    Guide: Cooldowns (Warcraft Tavern) · Cooldowns (Icy Veins)
  • Optional: Cast Overpower more: 0 casts vs 16 in the sim≈ +13 DPS
    When the target dodges and your rage is low, the sim swaps to Battle Stance for Overpower and back. It only pays with Tactical Mastery (rage kept on the swap) and when the swap won't delay Bloodthirst or Whirlwind. If you are unsure, skip it: it is a small filler.
    Guide: Stance dancing (Warcraft Tavern) · Overpower and Rend (Icy Veins)
  • Optional: Cast Rend more: 0 casts vs 8 in the sim≈ +6 DPS
    The sim weaves Rend in Battle Stance only on one target, at low rage, when it can swap back without delaying Bloodthirst or Whirlwind. It is a small gain: skip it on short fights, on bleed-immune targets, or if it costs you Bloodthirst timing.
    Guide: Stance dancing (Warcraft Tavern) · Overpower and Rend (Icy Veins)
  • Everything else≈ +1 DPS
    Small differences from the sim that are too small to list or have no DPS number (like Battle Shout uptime), plus a little sim randomness. With this line, the play tips add up to your possible gain.
